title: Grace Courtesy Days on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Payoff Quotes
content:
**Grace courtesy.** On a customer payoff quote for a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, some of the quote interest days after the maturity date are not charged, according to the balloon late charges assessed in the 12 calendar months ending on the quote date:

| Balloon late charges in the 12 months | Quote interest days after maturity not charged |
|---|---|
| None | 7 |
| One or two | 3 |
| Three or more | None |

The courtesy days come only out of the quote interest days after the maturity date. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the quote date takes in the dates on or before the quote date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

*Hypothetical:* two late charges in the window and 5 quote interest days after maturity: 3 of them are not charged.
